name: Guidde
description:
Guidde MCP connects Claude to your organization's Guidde library — the recorded video walkthroughs your team has already created for internal processes, tools, and workflows.

Ask a question in plain language, and Claude searches your workspace for the relevant walkthrough, reads through its steps, and answers with a citation back to the original Guidde. Every answer is grounded in real content your team recorded — never invented, never pulled from generic web knowledge.

The connector exposes four tools that Claude uses automatically based on what you ask:

Search your library by topic, with optional filters for app, tag, creator, or channel
Open a specific Guidde and return its steps as numbered instructions
List the channels you belong to, so searches can be scoped
Identify you, so searches can be personalized (e.g. "find my Guiddes")

Permissions match exactly what you already have in Guidde. A Guidde that's private to someone else, or in a channel you don't belong to, is invisible to the connector — it won't appear in search and can't be opened by link either.

This connector is read-only: it can search and read your library, but cannot create, edit, publish, or delete anything. Content creation via MCP is on the roadmap.

No API keys required — you sign in with your Guidde account in a browser and approve the connection. Access expires automatically after 14 days; reconnect any time from Settings → Connectors.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Guidde to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Guidde to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.guidde.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Guidde MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Guidde provides these MCP tools: guidde_channels, guidde_get, guidde_identity, and guidde_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Guidde?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Guidde in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Guidde requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Guidde is developed by Guidde. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
